info.description: User comments on announcements and wiki pages. Anchored by targetType + targetDocumentId (the target's documentId). DEPRECATED: targetId (numeric row id) — Strapi 5 publishes by delete+recreate, so the row id changes on every re-publish and the comment detaches (issue #11). It is kept as the bridge for the bootstrap backfill and as the rollback anchor, and is DUAL-WRITTEN for the transition period (new rows carry the anchor AND the target's current row id, so a rollback to the id-only code still finds them). The follow-up ticket to #11 drops this column, the dual-write and the legacy read branches together.
